item.title: Show HN: Python Projects in the Browser – Event ticket preview
item.summary: This has been my nights/weekends project. It is an online platform to learn how to code with the Python programming language through guided projects and interactive lessons. There is a full runtime and code editor embedded in the browser along with graded tasks/exercises. Any and all feedback is appreciated!
